body:
2nd Experience, Same Day as 1st Experience
Second trip:  2hrs and 30 min after first trip.
OMG, amazing.  I met the queen.  She frightened me.
50mg of a tarry reddish brown residue from ACRB A/B reduction smoked in glass pipe.  Very few white crystals. Held in smoke as long as I could.  Bedroom setting, no overhead lights.  Fan was on in the background and the light was not as bright but still natural and low due to the curtains being in place.  Left the bathroom door open and vanity light on which I could see from the bed; an oversight.
Deeply inhaled and held smoke in my lungs and put down pipe and lighter.
Overall the trip was as orgasmic as my first trip, maybe more so.  Same feeling of energy radiating from my body as my first trip, same waves of orgasmic feelings, but no actual orgasm.
Immediately lightheaded the sound disappeared and then instant colors and propelled through space.  I was instantly transported to a room that had a floor and only two walls, in front and to my right.  No ceiling or walls to my left or behind.  After the background noise disappeared a new sound arose which sounded like the first Matrix movie when Neo touches the mirror and gets covered in silver and the camera goes down his throat.  I cant describe it but it was that sound as I was propelled through space.
Inside the room was a metallic very high frequency buzzing, which replaced the Matrix sound, and thats where I met the Queen. The room was very square, but at an angle to the horizontal (15-degree tilt clockwise) and its walls and floor were covered with red, green white and black diamonds. The junctures of the walls and floor and tops and sides of the wall (where they ended) were black lines.  I could see around the wall in front of me that there were other rooms, or cells, and maybe this was a hive.  The queen entered the room from around the wall in front of me.  Her legs were black but she did not move them, just hovered towards me.  I was frightened by her, but also found her attractive and I was sexually attracted to her.   I felt she did not want me there, and I was happy to oblige her.  She was insectile in appearance, but had no antennae and only four appendages (arms and legs).  Large round head compared to her body but her torso was constricted like a wasp at her waist.  Her colors were the same colors as the room, but she was mainly white on her body, had black arms and legs, but with red and green as highlights.  She had black eyes, very large on the sides of her head but no discernible nose or mouth.  There was an intense humming coming from her that I could barely stand and it humbled me.
I was sent out of her space and opened my eyes while in bed.  I was aware that I was moaning again with the waves of energy rolling through my body.  I looked at the bed spread and it had the same effect as my first trip; the pattern was six inches above the fabric and vibrating.  I looked into the bathroom and the cabinet lines were wavering, and there were very small snake bodies and heads above the knobs on my wifes side of the bathroom. The colors were very intense, and bright, but still the same color as the cabinets are in actual life.   I then looked to my right at the clock on the dresser, which said 3:23pm, and then at my right hand and forearm. I was laying on my right side with a pillow under my head.  I could see through the skin of my hand and arm and see patterns and a civilization underneath my skin.
My hand was outlined in reds and oranges, like a 3D movie viewed without the glasses but red and orange effect.  Each knuckle had an eye under the skin, then faces, and then the back of my hand was like a compass rose used to mark old nautical charts.  Different patterns came and went under my skin but it was comforting and reassuring.
Different patterns came and went under my skin but it was comforting and reassuring.
I came to the realization we are all just energy, collected from past experiences and lives of others.
My forearm had a city underneath the skin.  I could see trees and buildings in green colors primarily, but accented with reds/oranges.  Then I saw a vehicle that started at my wrist and went up my forearm. I was like a car but without wheels and I could only see the upper half of it.  I also saw a dragon wrapped around my wrist and forearm, and then a tiger. This effect continued for about 20 minutes.
After the queen, watching the civilization under the skin of my forearm and the patterns on the back of my hands and fingers was very reassuring and comforting.  I kept telling the queen I would not come back, and I asked her to bestow gifts of knowledge upon me, and to keep the visions coming.  I felt the visions under my skin were a gift from the queen.
As the effect started to subside, (about the 30 min mark) I picked up the pipe again and reheated it, getting a little more smoke which I inhaled.  I told the queen I wasnt coming back and closed my eyes.  I saw a bluish grey space and felt myself flying through it.  I dont know where I was flying to, but only wanted to continue to see the patterns under my skin.  I opened my eyes and the patterns were there again, but less intense and less vivid.  They gradually faded at about the 40-45 min mark and I regained my full faculties.
